equations.name: monomial_derivative
equations.zero_convention: if alpha[i,l]==0 set derivative exactly0 first; never evaluate a negative exponent at M[i]=0
assumptions: state-independent prescribed k(t), or extra k derivatives included separately

equations.name: causal_endpoint
guards: same nominal K family, norm, clock and H as certificate

equations.name: HD_scalar_error
guards: identical declared kf,d,pi in fine and coarse

auxiliary.v_star: Delta_d/2 is always safe; tighter actual bound optional
auxiliary.dbar_lower: min(d_lower) is always safe; tighter actual bound optional
auxiliary.theta_star: explicit supplied bound on ||alpha-pi||_1; universal2 permitted only as labeled conditional bound, no alpha default

equations.name: positive_exponential_upper
equations.exact: Augment M=[[a,b,g_r],[c,d,g_e],[0,0,0]]. sigma>=max(0,-d); C=H*(M+sigma*I)>=0. z=||C||_inf. S_N=sum(C^j/j!,j=0..N). tail=z^(N+1)/(N+1)!/(1-z/(N+2)). exp(HM)<=exp_upper(-sigma*H)*(S_N+tail*ones_matrix).
guards: explicit nondimensional coordinate scales for augmented matrix
no signed-series truncation claimed as upper
equations.alternate_algorithm: Any algorithm with an equally explicit entrywise upper proof is admissible.

coefficient_api.arithmetic: exact rational for supplied interval endpoints and all coefficient arithmetic

density_box.covers: both fine aggregated and coarse states over the whole block

rate_inputs.d: one [lower,upper] per declared HD state; no inferred vector from aggregate rate
rate_inputs.pi: intervals covering a simplex-valued locally absolutely continuous lift; no automatic renormalization
rate_inputs.branch_distance_upper: required explicit theta bound or explicitly labeled universal-simplex2
rate_inputs.coarse_scalar_defect_upper: 0 only for exact same-source model; otherwise supplied nonnegative actual defect bound

optional_tightening.dbar_lower: must be proven <=d^T*pi for all admissible states
optional_tightening.variation_norm_upper: must cover ||D*pi-pi*dbar||_1; default mathematical safe bound is Delta/2

reject: negative rates or density lower bounds
invalid simplex enclosure or state lengths
simultaneous TIQM and SQM activation for one physical event
physical consumer default from synthetic fixture
incompatible initial invariant class in scalar eta adapter
K-only rho attached to full L while -wQD feedback omitted

outputs: separate interior evaluator or documented interior upper
endpoint_api.integration_relation: This is a comparison bound API; it is not itself an invariant-preserving discrete integrator for the fine physical ODE.

inherited_evidence.reuse: source-labelled exact event directions; no compiler replay
native source qualification and alternatives; no rate evaluation
nominal generator contraction and exact exponential primitive proofs

source_binding_limitations: R4 formation uses p-H2(v0,j0), whereas GL2022 destruction uses a thermal HD ensemble and spin-weighted H2 products.
Closed common H2/HD pools require explicit state matching; opposite integer directions do not make the two supplied coefficients a detailed-balance pair.
Actual branch, destruction vector, collider density/history, clock, initial state and named consumer remain input-pending.
discriminating_controls: H/D/charge invariants and scalar eta reduction
entrywise exp/integral upper versus independent reference

standards_and_novelty.primary_read: https://arxiv.org/html/2004.11961v2 §2 Definition1 and Jacobian row-space characterization
standards_and_novelty.distinction: CLUE constructs exact polynomial lumpings; R7 bounds specified positive-lift residuals and causal finite-block feedback.
